stem: The sheet below is folded to form a cube. Which face will be opposite the face with 6 dots?
explanation: Folding the net gives the opposite-face pairs 6–4, 2–3, 5–1 (in a net, two faces with exactly one square between them in a straight line are opposite; any two squares sharing an edge are adjacent). So 4 dots is opposite 6 dots: option D. A is wrong: the face with 1 dots shares an edge with the 6-dot face. B is wrong: the face with 2 dots shares an edge with the 6-dot face. C is wrong: the face with 3 dots shares an edge with the 6-dot face.
